diagnosis: SPY SMA(20/50) crossover produced closed PnL of 226.09 but equity change of only 321.65 versus buy-hold return of 14.5093 on 8253 bars, indicating substantial lag in capturing the dominant uptrend; BTC and ETH SMA(10/30) on short 350-bar samples generated net losses of -698.19 and -247.11 respectively with very low trade counts (6-7 trades), reflecting infrequent signals and poor timing amid high crypto volatility.

hypotheses.change: Add a longer-term trend filter such as requiring price above 200-SMA before permitting any short-term SMA crossover entries
hypotheses.why: A persistent equity bull market favors long-biased or trend-following rules that avoid counter-trend shorts; this economically aligns position direction with the dominant macro regime, reducing drag versus buy-hold.

hypotheses.change: Replace fixed SMA lookbacks with volatility-adjusted periods (e.g. ATR-scaled or adaptive moving averages)
hypotheses.why: Crypto exhibits extreme regime shifts in volatility; fixed short windows generate noisy, low-frequency signals on 350 bars while equity benefits from smoother adaptation that better matches realized price dynamics.

hypotheses.change: Incorporate multi-timeframe confirmation (e.g. daily SMA cross validated by weekly trend) or volume-weighted signals
hypotheses.why: Single-daily-bar rules ignore higher-timeframe structure and participation; adding confirmation economically improves signal quality by filtering against noise and aligning with broader market participation.
